verdict.rationale: The axis applies because SAM.gov is an online registration and filing portal. However, the evidence documents no keyless or file-number entry path into the core flow (entity registration or getting a Unique Entity ID). The API docs say keys are tied to SAM.gov accounts that registered users obtain, and system accounts must be created and approved. Public lookup pages and crawlable content paths are adjacent features and do not show the core flow can start without an account.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
